correctness.rationale: The exact published survival is regularly varying with exponent \(-\kappa\eta\). Differentiating its continuous interpolation gives logarithmic derivative asymptotic \(-\kappa\eta/x\), and the mean-value theorem therefore yields the exact PMF order \(p_n\sim2^\kappa\kappa\eta n^{-\kappa\eta-1}\). The positive-moment threshold is then the ordinary p-series boundary, including divergence at equality. Positive exponential moments diverge because their summands fail to approach zero. The bundled checker confirms the exact formulas numerically but is not used as proof.

value.rationale: Moments, skewness, kurtosis, coefficient of variation, and dispersion are central advertised mathematical properties of the new distribution. The sharp phase diagram establishes exactly when each population quantity exists, invalidates at least one finite printed statistic in four of six showcase rows, and shows that the ordinary MGF has no positive-side domain. This is a structural convergence theorem with direct consequences for the paper's principal summary table, not a routine recomputation.
